entries.purpose: Get paginated, filtered, searchable list of products for the product grid with lazy loading.
entries.request_body: category (string, optional), search (string, optional), page (int, optional), page_size (int, optional)
entries.response: { products: [{ id, name, description, image_url, category_id, is_featured }], total_count, page, page_size }

entries.purpose: List all product categories for use in category grid and filter dropdown.
